title: Norwegian Banana Omelette
description: A warm and wholesome Norwegian-inspired omelette filled with sweet bananas.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the butter and let it melt.
Pour in the eggs and let them cook for about 30 seconds.
Add the sliced banana on one half of the omelette.
Sprinkle the vanilla extract and a pinch of salt over the banana.
Fold the other half of the omelette over the filling.
Cook for another 30-60 seconds, until the eggs are almost set.
Slide the omelette out of the pan onto a plate.
